Arch Rock at golden hour, and Marcus's s'mores theory
Ryan Mountain, sore legs, one last fire

sideQuests.title: The long way back from Hidden Valley
sideQuests.blurb: They missed the loop turnoff, found a lizard the size of a shoe, and arrived 40 minutes late with no regrets.

behindTheCamera.line: Ana took 41 of your 64 photos. She's in exactly one.

narration.speaker: Jules
narration.line: We rolled into Jumbo Rocks after dark, and the first tent went up inside out.

narration.speaker: Priya
narration.line: By morning Hidden Valley was glowing, and Priya and Dev were already lost in it.
narration.voice: we are NOT lost we are exploring

narration.speaker: Marcus
narration.line: At Arch Rock, Marcus explained his s'mores theory to anyone who stood still.
narration.voice: the marshmallow has to be the last layer, trust me

narration.speaker: Ana
narration.line: On Ryan Mountain the wind took Dev's hat, and nobody has let him forget it.
narration.voice: somebody get a photo of this, not me for once

nextFire.headline: Anza-Borrego, two hours closer and free to park

the $30 parking pass hurt my soul
I want to see the wildflowers everyone keeps posting
somewhere we can actually see stars
